name: mirage
text: Novig bids are recovering right now. They sank to about 130 resting, then jumped to 373 in the last pass (249 posted), with about 1,950 more waiting. The engine sends at most 250 new bids per pass, so it should climb back toward 900 and beyond over the next several passes. The dip: the desk took down 30-50 bids per pass for a while, and Novig repeatedly answered 'slow down' (rate limit), which cut how many it could post. I haven't pinned down why it fell from 900; I'll check again in a few passes and tell you if it stalls rather than climbs.
